Class PetriObjModel

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.PetriObjModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class PetriObjModel extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
This class provides constructing Petri object model.
List of Petri-objects contains Petri-objects with links between them.
For creating Petri-object use class PetriSim. For linking Petri-objects use combining places and passing tokens.
Method DoT() of class PetriSim provides programming the passing tokens from the transition of one Petri-object to the place of other.
Author:
Inna V. Stetsenko

    • linkObjectsCombiningPlaces

      public void linkObjectsCombiningPlaces(int oneObject, int onePlace, int otherObject, int otherPlace)
      Merges a place of one Petri-object with a place of another: from now on both objects see the same marking through the same PetriP instance.
      Parameters:
      oneObject - index of the object whose place slot is redirected
      onePlace - index of that place inside the object's net
      otherObject - index of the object that owns the resulting shared place
      otherPlace - index of that place inside the other object's net

    • linkTransitionToPlace

      public void linkTransitionToPlace(int sourceObject, int sourceTransition, int targetObject, int targetPlace, int quantity)
      Makes a transition of one Petri-object deliver tokens straight into a place of another one, without the source object owning a matching output place.
      Parameters:
      sourceObject - index of the object that owns the firing transition
      sourceTransition - index of that transition inside the source object's net
      targetObject - index of the object that owns the receiving place
      targetPlace - index of that place inside the target object's net
      quantity - how many tokens each firing delivers

    • applyLinks

      public void applyLinks()
      Wires every declared link into the object graph.

      Meant for a model whose Petri-objects are freshly built — that is, whose places are not shared and whose transitions carry no ExternalArc yet. Inter-object arcs are dropped first, but a place fusion cannot be undone, so replaying the declarations over an already linked model would chain fusions further instead of reproducing them.
